product.title: La9odam Modern Sports Shoe
product.description: Experience comfort and style with La9odam – a sleek, lightweight, and durable design built to keep you moving forward. Perfect for everyday wear and athletic performance.

story.intro: In a world crowded with overdesigned footwear and loud marketing that tries too hard, we chose to go back in time—back to authenticity, fairness, and simplicity that speaks for itself.
story.origins: We revived a design that has always been a symbol of Shaolin strength and discipline: the shoe worn by kung fu masters, seen in Henan Tempels, on global stages, and at the Olympics.
story.qualities: It's a timeless design that doesn’t age, crafted from simple materials proven to be comfortable, light, and durable. This shoe is a reminder that the things made without show-off or noise are the ones that truly last.
story.collaboration: We partnered with the original factory—the one that lost the rights to its own creation after an unfair legal battle. We chose to help return what was taken from them. Because fairness matters. Because craft should remain in the hands that built it.
story.learnMore: Learn more about Lqdam and about DAFU Rubber Company, the factory that started the story.

philosophy.intro: Every Lqdam pair carries the same spirit as the original: flexible, steady, and made for movement.
philosophy.design: Lqdam is light, comfortable, and built to last—designed to offer lasting comfort, simply, without complexity, and at a fair price.
philosophy.simplicity: Lqdam, which means "Leap Forward" in Arabic, is a movement and a voice we want everyone to hear. It's a message that says: what was taken should be returned to its rightful owners, and that you should stand bold, stay unafraid, and always move forward.
philosophy.learnMore: Learn more about our story here.

AboutFull.title: Lqdam — Our Story
AboutFull.intro:
In a world full of noise — notifications, trends that last minutes, designs that try too hard, and marketing that manipulates more than it inspires — Lqdam began with the courage to simplify.
A movement built on the belief that real progress starts with honesty, not hype; with roots, not noise.
Lqdam means “Leap Forward” in Arabic.
We believed that in order to leap forward, we must first look back.
Lqdam returns to the past not out of nostalgia, but out of clarity.
We looked back so we can move forward with intention and purpose — with meaning, clarity, and a sense of who we are.
Lqdam is born from the Arab spirit — from a generation of young people whose voices, talents, and ideas deserve to be seen and heard, and whose culture lives in everything they do: in the way they walk, dress, move, create, and carry their stories forward.
This movement exists to empower and include.
To stand with the underrepresented.
To give space to stories that rarely appear in glossy campaigns.
To celebrate our humor, our roots, our identity, and the shared culture that connects us across borders.
AboutFull.inspiration:
To understand Lqdam, you have to step into Shanghai — into its narrow alleyways, old martial arts schools, and the workshops of Dafu Rubber Company.
For decades, they crafted the Shanghai kung-fu shoe — a simple canvas shoe worn by Shaolin monks, kung-fu masters, students, workers, and everyday people who just needed something honest and reliable.
That shoe travelled through time not because of trends or marketing, but because it worked.
It became a cultural symbol, carried across generations and borders, shaped by the people who lived in it.
Its journey wasn’t always simple — ownership shifted, stories changed, the world got louder — but the spirit never faded.
A humble design, built with sincerity, earned its place in history.
That spirit is what inspired us.
AboutFull.why:
We chose to work directly with the original makers in Shanghai to revive the essence of the Shanghai kung-fu shoe — not as a replica of the past, but as a foundation for movement, meaning, and modern purpose.
Lqdam is here to remind us that simplicity is strength.
That heritage is not a burden, but a compass.
And that a real leap forward happens when you understand where you came from and where you want to go.
This is a shoe made for movement — physical, cultural, and personal.
Made for the young voices shaping tomorrow.
Made for the storytellers, the fighters, the creators, the overlooked, the bold.
A shoe made to inspire you to move —
clearly, honestly, confidently —
always forward… لقدّام.
